from.event: Alexander Graham Bell patents the telephone. For the first time, a voice can travel down a wire to another town.

to.event: Alexander Graham Bell patents the telephone. For the first time, a voice can travel down a wire to another town.
to.alt: An early wooden telephone has a large round speaking opening, pale coils, a horseshoe-shaped magnet and two wires.

from.event: Karl Benz patents a gasoline car with three wheels. Almost nobody has one yet.

to.event: Karl Benz patents a gasoline car with three wheels. Almost nobody has one yet.
to.alt: An open motor carriage has one front wheel, two large rear wheels, a bench seat and a steering tiller.

from.event: Orville and Wilbur Wright fly a powered plane at Kitty Hawk. The first flight lasts about twelve seconds.

to.event: Orville and Wilbur Wright fly a powered plane at Kitty Hawk. The first flight lasts about twelve seconds.
to.alt: A biplane with a small elevator ahead of its wings flies low over sand. One person lies flat at the controls while another runs beside it.

from.event: Philo Farnsworth sends the first electronic television picture. It is a single straight line.

to.event: Philo Farnsworth sends the first electronic television picture. It is a single straight line.
to.alt: A dark screen inside a plain wooden edge shows a single bright horizontal white line.

from.event: Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin walk on the Moon while people all over the world watch on television.

to.event: Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin walk on the Moon while people all over the world watch on television.
to.alt: A person in a white spacesuit stands on gray ground with bootprints behind. A small blue-and-white crescent Earth appears in the black sky.

from.event: Tim Berners-Lee puts the first website online and opens the World Wide Web to anyone outside his lab.

to.event: Tim Berners-Lee puts the first website online and opens the World Wide Web to anyone outside his lab.
to.alt: A boxy beige computer shows three colored shapes on its small screen. A cable runs down from the desk.

from.event: Touch-screen smartphones go on sale. A phone, a camera, a map and the web all fit in one pocket.

to.event: Touch-screen smartphones go on sale. A phone, a camera, a map and the web all fit in one pocket.
to.alt: One hand holds a flat rectangular phone whose screen shows a grid of nine colored squares.
